methodology.label: Repository quality signals
methodology.disclaimer: Signals describe public repository readiness, not a security audit, support promise, or production certification.

modules.title: AI Agent Skills
modules.summary: Shared skills for AI coding tools, starting with a module-standards audit covering code quality, tests, admin experience, security, and documentation.
modules.howToUse: Install the module-standards skill in an Agent Skills-compatible tool, then use it to review and improve a Mage-OS or Magento module one area at a time.
modules.requirements: An Agent Skills-compatible coding tool, such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, or Cursor
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Extension Directory
modules.summary: A searchable directory of open-source Mage-OS and Magento extensions, available on the web and inside the admin.
modules.howToUse: Install the admin module to browse compatibility and quality signals under System → Extensions → Extension Directory, or use the public directory site.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2.4
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: GraphQL Playground
modules.summary: An in-store GraphiQL workspace for exploring Mage-OS and Magento GraphQL queries and mutations.
modules.howToUse: Enable the module, then open /graphiql while the store is in developer mode.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2 with GraphQL
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The maintainers explicitly state that this module is not intended for production use.

modules.title: OpenCode Custom Platform
modules.summary: Connects Symfony AI and Mage-OS AI Base to a self-hosted OpenCode server while keeping provider credentials on that server.
modules.howToUse: Install the Composer library, secure an OpenCode server, then configure its base URL and model through AI Base.
modules.requirements: PHP; Symfony AI; a secured OpenCode server
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: OpenCode Zen Platform
modules.summary: Adds OpenCode Zen chat-completion models to Symfony AI and Mage-OS AI Base.
modules.howToUse: Install the Composer library, add an OpenCode Zen credential in AI Base, and select a supported model.
modules.requirements: PHP; Symfony AI; an OpenCode Zen API key
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: LLMs.txt
modules.summary: Creates an editable llms.txt for a store, with optional OpenAI-assisted content generation.
modules.howToUse: Configure the module under Stores → Configuration → AI → LLMs.txt, generate or edit the content, then publish it at /llms.txt.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2.4.x; OpenAI API key for assisted generation
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Mage-OS Installer
modules.summary: An interactive installer that prepares a local Mage-OS project using DDEV or Warden.
modules.howToUse: Run mage-os-install in the directory where you want a project and follow the environment and admin setup prompts.
modules.install: Download a release binary, or run: go install github.com/mage-os-lab/mage-os-installer@latest
modules.requirements: Docker plus DDEV or Warden
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Magento Workflows
modules.summary: A native trigger-condition-action engine for automating store operations with an admin builder, REST API, CLI, and dry-run support.
modules.howToUse: Evaluate it in development, build a workflow from a trigger, conditions, and actions, then test it in dry-run mode before activation.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; currently pre-alpha
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The project is pre-alpha and should not yet be used in production.

modules.title: Magento 2 LSP & MCP
modules.summary: Magento-aware language and MCP servers for navigation, diagnostics, refactoring, and merged configuration insight.
modules.howToUse: Install the package globally, then configure magento2-lsp in an editor or magento2-lsp-mcp in an AI coding agent.
modules.requirements: Node.js 20+
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Pretty CLI
modules.summary: Reusable components for producing clearer output in Mage-OS console commands.
modules.howToUse: Reference the package from a custom console command and use its output components.
modules.requirements: See repository documentation
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: This repository is archived and no longer actively maintained.

modules.title: Migrate Magento 2 to Mage-OS
modules.summary: A guided shell migration that switches a compatible Magento Open Source installation to Mage-OS packages.
modules.howToUse: Back up and test on staging, review the migration script, then run the command documented in the repository.
modules.requirements: Magento Open Source 2.4.9; developer mode; local or staging environment; shell access
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Admin Assistant
modules.summary: Adds an AI chat assistant to the Magento admin for store operations and contextual help.
modules.howToUse: Install and enable the module, configure an AI provider, then use the assistant from the admin panel.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; supported AI provider credentials
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Admin User Time Zone
modules.summary: Lets each admin user view backend dates and times in their own time zone.
modules.howToUse: Install the module, run setup:upgrade, and choose a time zone in each admin user profile.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Advanced Widget
modules.summary: Extends CMS widgets with configurable repeatable rows, image pickers, product pickers, and richer fields.
modules.howToUse: Install the module, define an advanced widget, then configure its repeatable content in Page Builder or CMS.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; Page Builder Widget dependency
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Answer Engine Optimisation
modules.summary: Publishes machine-readable store and catalogue information for AI assistants through llms.txt and related feeds.
modules.howToUse: Install the module, configure its answer-engine feeds, then validate the generated crawler files and catalogue output.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.3–8.5; Magento 2.4.7+ or Mage-OS; SEO ^2.0
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Agentic Commerce
modules.summary: Explores the store APIs and capabilities needed for AI agents to discover and complete commerce tasks.
modules.howToUse: Review the documented agent endpoints and evaluate the current implementation in a development store.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; evolving agent tooling
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: AI Base
modules.summary: A shared configuration and adapter layer for modules that need one or more AI backends.
modules.howToUse: Install and enable the module, configure providers under Services → AI Configuration, then integrate through its provider interfaces.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.2+; Mage-OS or Magento 2
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: AI Shopping Assistant
modules.summary: A streaming shopping assistant for Hyvä and Luma that searches products, explains choices, manages carts, checks orders, and answers store-policy questions.
modules.howToUse: Install with AI Base, configure an AI service and the storefront panel, then test product search, cart actions, order lookup, and policy answers in development.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.2–8.5; Magento 2.4.7+ or Mage-OS; AI Base; Hyvä 1.5+ with Tailwind 4 or a Luma-based theme
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: Renamed from Claude Consumer Agent; existing installations need the migration steps in the README.

modules.title: Alpine Loader
modules.summary: An early proof of concept for initializing Alpine.js in a Mage-OS storefront.
modules.howToUse: Evaluate from source in a development store; the public API and feature set are still being defined.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The README labels this as a proof of concept and does not yet document finished features.

modules.title: Alpine Local Storage
modules.summary: Provides local-storage behaviour for the experimental Alpine-based storefront module set.
modules.howToUse: Install alongside the related Alpine storefront modules and validate the integration in a development environment.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; related Alpine storefront modules
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Alpine Messages
modules.summary: Implements storefront message handling for the experimental Alpine-based frontend stack.
modules.howToUse: Install alongside the Alpine module set and test storefront notices and session messages in development.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; related Alpine storefront modules
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Alpine Minicart
modules.summary: An Alpine.js implementation of the Mage-OS storefront minicart experience.
modules.howToUse: Install it as part of the Alpine storefront stack and validate cart behaviour with the selected theme.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; related Alpine storefront modules
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Blog
modules.summary: A full blog for Mage-OS and Magento with authors, scheduling, SEO, RSS, widgets, GraphQL, Luma, and Hyvä support.
modules.howToUse: Enable the module, manage posts and taxonomy in the admin, then place its routes or widgets in the storefront.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.2+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; Luma or Hyvä
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Blog Hyvä Compatibility
modules.summary: Hyvä storefront templates and compatibility work for the Mage-OS Blog module.
modules.howToUse: Install it with the main Blog module when the storefront uses a Hyvä theme.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS Blog and a Hyvä theme
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Blog SEO Bridge
modules.summary: Connects the Blog and SEO modules so each post has one consistent BlogPosting description and shared organisation identity in its structured data.
modules.howToUse: Install alongside Blog and SEO, then configure the organisation under Marketing → SEO → Organization; no extra bridge settings are required.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.3–8.5; Magento 2.4.7+ or Mage-OS; Blog ^1.3; SEO ^2.0
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: AI Catalog Data
modules.summary: Generates and refines product descriptions and other catalog content with an AI provider.
modules.howToUse: Configure an AI provider, then generate content from supported product-editing workflows in the admin.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; AI provider credentials
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Catalog Image Cleanup
modules.summary: Finds unused product and category image files, cleans old resized copies, and removes unreferenced images after catalogue changes.
modules.howToUse: Run mageos:catalog-images:cleanup with --dry-run first, review the report, then use --backup to move unused files before enabling automatic cleanup.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; local media filesystem
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: Back up media before cleanup. The CLI does not scan remote storage such as S3.

modules.title: Checkout Guard
modules.summary: Blocks unused REST payment routes and deactivates carts after repeated failures to reduce automated card-testing attacks.
modules.howToUse: Configure the payment routes used by the storefront and set failure limits, then monitor blocked requests before tightening enforcement.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; Magewire or headless checkout
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Customer Two-Factor Authentication
modules.summary: Adds customer TOTP authentication, recovery codes, admin reset controls, and Luma and Hyvä storefront support.
modules.howToUse: Install the module, enable customer two-factor authentication, and let customers enrol an authenticator from their account.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; Luma or Hyvä
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Digital Signature
modules.summary: Builds order contract PDFs and sends them to an external provider for digital signature.
modules.howToUse: Configure a signature provider and PDF template, then initiate and track signing for eligible orders.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1–8.5; Mage-OS or Magento 2; supported signature provider
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: EAV Debug Views
modules.summary: Creates database views that flatten EAV entity values into easier-to-query JSON structures.
modules.howToUse: Install in a development environment and query the generated database views during debugging or data analysis.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2.4.x; database access
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: Designed for development and debugging; the maintainers advise evaluating database overhead before production use.

modules.title: FAQ
modules.summary: Manages customer-facing FAQs and the structured data that helps search and answer engines understand them.
modules.howToUse: Create and organise FAQs in the admin, publish them in the storefront, and validate the generated schema.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.3–8.5; Magento 2.4.7+ or Mage-OS; SEO ^2.0; optional Page Builder
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Flexible Ads
modules.summary: A newly reserved Lab project for flexible promotional and advertising content.
modules.howToUse: Not installable yet; follow the repository as the initial scope is defined.
modules.requirements: Not yet documented
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The repository was created recently and does not yet contain an implementation.

modules.title: Hreflang
modules.summary: Adds locale-aware hreflang links for CMS pages, products, and categories.
modules.howToUse: Install and enable the module, then configure locale relationships for relevant store views and URLs.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Inline Admin Documentation
modules.summary: Adds local documentation cards for around 7,400 core configuration fields, including accepted values and technical details.
modules.howToUse: Install the module, enable Inline Documentation under Stores → Configuration → Advanced, then use the help markers beside configuration fields.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; no external documentation service required
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: MaxMind GeoIP Redirect
modules.summary: Routes visitors to an appropriate store view using MaxMind GeoLite2 location data, with IPv4, IPv6, and Varnish support.
modules.howToUse: Install the module, provide a GeoLite2 database, and configure country-to-store redirect rules.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; MaxMind GeoLite2 data
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: NetSuite Connector
modules.summary: Synchronises products, customers, orders, inventory, and related commerce data between Mage-OS and Oracle NetSuite.
modules.howToUse: Configure NetSuite SOAP credentials, map the required records, then use the queue and monitoring tools to stage a controlled rollout.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; Oracle NetSuite SOAP access
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The connector is evolving and does not provide an automatic migration from earlier Rocket Web modules.

modules.title: Newsletter Coupon
modules.summary: Creates a unique cart-rule coupon for each new newsletter subscriber and includes it in the welcome email.
modules.howToUse: Configure the source cart rule and newsletter behaviour, then the module generates coupons during subscription.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: OpenSearch Hybrid
modules.summary: Combines native keyword results with semantic reranking while preserving facets, counts, per-store controls, and fallback behaviour.
modules.howToUse: Enable it on a development store, configure the semantic model, and compare ranked results against the native search fallback.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS 3.5; OpenSearch; embedding model
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The repository describes the current implementation as an engineering pilot.

modules.title: OpenSearch Relevance Workbench
modules.summary: Lets merchants compare search tuning candidates, rate real results, review evidence, and activate or roll back accepted settings.
modules.howToUse: Create a candidate in the admin workbench, run guided result reviews, then activate it only after the evidence is accepted.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; OpenSearch
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: OpenTelemetry
modules.summary: A reserved Lab project for adding OpenTelemetry traces and metrics to Mage-OS and Magento.
modules.howToUse: Not installable yet; follow the repository for its first implementation.
modules.requirements: Not yet documented
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The repository does not yet contain an implementation or usage documentation.

modules.title: Page Builder GraphQL
modules.summary: Converts Page Builder output into structured JSON for GraphQL and headless storefronts.
modules.howToUse: Install the module and request Page Builder content through its GraphQL fields instead of consuming rendered HTML.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2 with Page Builder and GraphQL
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Passkey Authentication
modules.summary: Adds customer passkey sign-in, account credential management, and an admin passkey two-factor provider.
modules.howToUse: Install over HTTPS, enable customer passkeys in Customer Configuration, and test registration, recovery, and sign-in for the selected storefront.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.2+; Magento 2.4.6+ or Mage-OS; HTTPS and a WebAuthn-capable browser
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Profiler
modules.summary: Adds table and JSON output formats to Magento profiling for easier analysis and tooling integrations.
modules.howToUse: Enable Magento profiling in development, select the table or JSON output type, then inspect request timings.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; developer environment
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Profiler Admin UI
modules.summary: Provides an admin viewer for the JSON profiling reports created by the Mage-OS Profiler module.
modules.howToUse: Install it with Mage-OS Profiler, generate JSON reports, then compare them in the admin viewer.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS Profiler; Mage-OS or Magento 2
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: RequireJS Optimizer
modules.summary: Removes selected unnecessary dependencies from generated RequireJS configuration assets.
modules.howToUse: Evaluate on a development store, configure replacement rules, and verify every affected storefront flow.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2 with RequireJS storefront assets
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The README describes this as a proof of concept with incomplete controller handling.

modules.title: SEO & Structured Data
modules.summary: A search and answer-engine foundation covering structured data, social metadata, canonicals, hreflang, and sitemaps, with separate FAQ, AEO, and Agentic companions.
modules.howToUse: Install the module, configure the required SEO features per store, then validate generated markup and crawler files.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.3–8.5; Magento 2.4.7+ or Mage-OS; Magento MSI inventory modules
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Shopping Feed
modules.summary: Builds scheduled product feeds for Google, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok, Pinterest, local inventory, promotions, and custom destinations.
modules.howToUse: Choose a channel preset or custom mapping, configure filters and delivery, then preview and schedule feed generation.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; channel account or delivery destination
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Social Login
modules.summary: Adds Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram sign-in for Mage-OS and Magento customer accounts.
modules.howToUse: Install the module, configure supported identity providers, and test sign-in and account-linking flows.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1–8.5; Magento 2.4.6+ or Mage-OS 3.x; identity-provider credentials
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Store Locator
modules.summary: Manages physical locations and helps customers find them with text search, maps, and browser geolocation.
modules.howToUse: Create stores in the admin, choose Google Maps or OpenStreetMap, then link the locator page from the storefront.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; map provider configuration
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Template Parser
modules.summary: A reserved Lab project for parsing Mage-OS and Magento template structures.
modules.howToUse: Not installable yet; follow the repository for its first documented implementation.
modules.requirements: Not yet documented
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The repository does not yet contain an implementation or usage documentation.

modules.title: UIkit Theme Utilities
modules.summary: Build and asset utilities used by the Mage-OS UIkit storefront theme.
modules.howToUse: Install it with theme-frontend-uikit, then use its asset compilation and theme utility features.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; UIkit frontend theme
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: UIkit JavaScript Replacement
modules.summary: Removes selected unnecessary JavaScript dependencies from UIkit-based storefront themes.
modules.howToUse: Test with the UIkit theme in development and verify affected customer journeys before wider use.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; UIkit frontend theme
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The README labels this a proof of concept and notes incomplete controller handling.

modules.title: UIkit Menu
modules.summary: Provides the storefront navigation implementation for the Mage-OS UIkit theme.
modules.howToUse: Install it with the UIkit theme and configure the standard catalog navigation.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; UIkit frontend theme
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: UIkit Product Page
modules.summary: Product-page layout and JavaScript adaptations for the Mage-OS UIkit theme.
modules.howToUse: Install it with the UIkit theme and validate product configuration, media, pricing, and cart interactions.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; UIkit frontend theme
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Widgetkit
modules.summary: A collection of Page Builder CMS widgets with previews and Hyvä-compatible Tailwind output.
modules.howToUse: Install the module, then add and configure its widget collection through Page Builder.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.1+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; Page Builder; Hyvä supported
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: FrankenPHP Worker Mode
modules.summary: Resets request-scoped Magento state so a store can run safely in FrankenPHP worker mode.
modules.howToUse: Install and enable the module, configure FrankenPHP worker mode, then load-test state isolation before production use.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.0–8.5; Mage-OS or Magento 2; FrankenPHP
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: FrankenPHP Worker Mode for Hyvä
modules.summary: Prevents Hyvä CSP state leaking between requests under FrankenPHP worker mode.
modules.howToUse: Install it alongside Worker Mode and Hyvä, then verify CSP behaviour across repeated worker requests.
modules.requirements: Worker Mode module; Hyvä theme module; FrankenPHP
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: ObjectManager Lazy Object Patch
modules.summary: Explores PHP 8.4 native lazy objects in the Magento ObjectManager to reduce request startup work.
modules.howToUse: Apply the patch with cweagans/composer-patches only in a controlled test environment and benchmark compatibility.
modules.requirements: PHP 8.4+; Mage-OS or Magento 2; composer-patches
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: The maintainers describe this as experimental and not yet battle-tested in production.

modules.title: UIkit Frontend Theme
modules.summary: A UIkit 3 storefront theme that retains native Magento LESS tooling and broad Luma-style compatibility.
modules.howToUse: Install the theme and its utilities module, register it in the admin, then inherit or customize it for the storefront.
modules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2; UIkit Theme Utilities module
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

modules.title: Web Installer
modules.summary: A browser-based setup experiment for installing Mage-OS.
modules.howToUse: Kept for historical reference; do not start a new installation workflow with this archived project.
modules.requirements: See repository documentation
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
modules.caveat: Archived after not reaching a stable release; the repository invites interested maintainers to contact Mage-OS.

modules.title: Magento 2 Snippets for Zed
modules.summary: Zed snippets for common Magento 2 and Hyvä PHP, XML, PHTML, CSP, and Alpine patterns.
modules.howToUse: Open Zed Extensions, search for “Magento 2 Snippets”, and install the extension.
modules.install: Install “Magento 2 Snippets” from the Zed Extensions panel
modules.requirements: Zed editor
modules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

graduatedModules.title: Admin Activity Log
graduatedModules.summary: Tracks admin changes, login attempts, and optional page visits, with before-and-after field values for auditing.
graduatedModules.howToUse: Configure Admin Activity under Stores → Configuration → Advanced → Admin, then review action and login logs under System → Admin Activity.
graduatedModules.requirements: PHP 8.2+; Magento Open Source 2.4.x or Mage-OS
graduatedModules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
graduatedModules.caveat: Continues the open-source KiwiCommerce Admin Activity extension; page-visit logging is optional.

graduatedModules.title: Automatic Translation
graduatedModules.summary: Translates products, categories, CMS pages, and blocks using DeepL, OpenAI, or Google Gemini, with scheduled product translation.
graduatedModules.howToUse: Configure an engine, API credentials, and source and target languages for each store view, then translate content in the admin or schedule product translations.
graduatedModules.requirements: PHP 8.2–8.5; Mage-OS or Magento 2; supported translation-provider credentials
graduatedModules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
graduatedModules.caveat: Duplicate CMS pages and blocks before translation, because translated content replaces the original when saved.

graduatedModules.title: Inventory Reservations Grid
graduatedModules.summary: Shows inventory reservations in the admin so store teams can inspect stock commitments and clean balanced reservations.
graduatedModules.howToUse: Open Stores → Inventory → Reservations to inspect reservations. Use role permissions and configuration to control cleanup and deletion actions.
graduatedModules.requirements: Mage-OS or Magento 2 with Multi-Source Inventory; Magento framework ^103.0
graduatedModules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
graduatedModules.caveat: Deleting uncompensated reservations can create stock inconsistencies; the mass-delete action is disabled by default.

graduatedModules.title: Meta Robots Tag
graduatedModules.summary: Controls noindex, nofollow, and noarchive directives for individual products, categories, and CMS pages.
graduatedModules.howToUse: Enable the module, then set the required robot directives in the Search Engine Optimization section of each product, category, or CMS page.
graduatedModules.requirements: PHP 8.2–8.5; Mage-OS or Magento 2 with Catalog and CMS modules
graduatedModules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
graduatedModules.caveat: An unchecked directive uses the store design configuration; it does not explicitly force indexing or following.

graduatedModules.title: Page Builder Widget
graduatedModules.summary: Adds a draggable CMS Widget component to Page Builder, with configurable widgets and supported live stage previews.
graduatedModules.howToUse: Add the CMS Widget component in Page Builder and select a widget. Developers can add preview templates, styles, and scripts through widget.xml.
graduatedModules.requirements: PHP 8.1–8.5; Mage-OS or Magento 2; Page Builder ^2.0
graduatedModules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

graduatedModules.title: Page Builder Template Import / Export
graduatedModules.summary: Shares Page Builder templates between stores as ZIP files, with optional remote template libraries in Dropbox.
graduatedModules.howToUse: Import or export templates under Content → Elements → Templates, or use the CLI. Configure Dropbox only if you need a remote template library.
graduatedModules.requirements: PHP 8.1–8.5; Mage-OS or Magento 2; Page Builder; PHP ZIP extension
graduatedModules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

graduatedModules.title: Returns & RMA
graduatedModules.summary: Manages return requests from customers and guests, with configurable reasons, statuses, attachments, messages, and admin workflows.
graduatedModules.howToUse: Enable Return Management under Stores → Configuration → Sales, configure your return policy, then manage requests under Sales → RMA.
graduatedModules.requirements: PHP 8.2–8.5; Mage-OS or Magento 2; Luma and Hyvä templates included
graduatedModules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

graduatedModules.title: Admin Theme Switcher
graduatedModules.summary: Lets administrators choose the active admin theme and provides the companion switcher for the Mage-OS M137 admin theme.
graduatedModules.howToUse: Install through the M137 admin theme package or on its own, then choose an installed theme under Stores → Configuration → Advanced → Admin → Admin Design.
graduatedModules.requirements: PHP 8.2–8.5; Mage-OS or Magento 2; an installed admin theme
graduatedModules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.

graduatedModules.title: Theme Optimization
graduatedModules.summary: Speeds up perceived storefront navigation with browser back/forward caching, speculative loading, and page transitions.
graduatedModules.howToUse: Configure back/forward cache, speculation rules, and view transitions under Stores → Configuration → Advanced → System, then test with your theme and caching setup.
graduatedModules.requirements: PHP 8.1–8.5; Magento 2.4.5+ or equivalent Mage-OS / Adobe Commerce
graduatedModules.compatibility: Check the package constraints and README against your store version before installing.
graduatedModules.caveat: Back/forward cache support may require extra Varnish or Fastly configuration; prerendering can affect analytics and dynamic UI.
